verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents a quote endpoint and SDK method for fiat-to-crypto buys that return a locked rate, fees and limits with short expiry, and a headless Buy frame that executes a transaction from the quote signature. That covers the fiat-to-crypto quote-and-execute core. Stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion appears only as marketing copy about token swaps, the off-ramp is shown only as a widget flow with requote webhooks, and settlement times are never documented. Missing for 10: a stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion API, a documented crypto-to-fiat conversion quote API, settlement time documentation, stablecoin-specific rate and fee documentation, and independent corroboration.
